datasets.name: ODSPayments
datasets.sql:
select p.rowid,p.id,p.ins_id,p.traid,p.ammount,p.paydate ,sb_p.name,p.planid,
/*CASE p.planid
  WHEN 2 THEN 'Hadiseye gore'
  WHEN 1 THEN 'Plan uzre'
  END as plantype*/
 decode( p.planid, 2,'Hadiseye gore',
                   1,'Plan uzre',
                    0,'Plandan kenar')as plantype
from ins_payments p,sb_business_processes sb_p,sb_business_opers sb_o,provarch pr
where p.traid=sb_o.parentid
and sb_o.busproc=sb_p.id
and  p.ins_id=:pcid
and sb_o.busproc in(14,15,16,17,18,19,20,63)
and pr.id=sb_o.parentid

datasets.name: ODSPlan
datasets.sql:
SELECT 1 as ID, 'Plan uzre' as paydate, 0 as ammount, 0 as status
  FROM DUAL
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 as ID, 'Hadiseye gore' as paydate, 0 as ammount, 0 as status
  FROM DUAL

datasets.name: DSRestPayment
datasets.sql:
select 
nvl((select nvl(ammount,0)+nvl(INS_PREMIUM,0)+nvl(RESP_PREMIUM,0)  as qaliq
from ins_contracts c,ins_contr_per_acc_motor f,ins_contract_responsibility m
where c.id=:pcid
and   f.cid(+)=c.id
and   m.cid(+)=c.id)-
(select nvl(sum(ammount),0) as ammount from ins_payments p, sb_business_opers b
where p.ins_id=:pcid
and p.traid=b.parentid
and p.planid=1
and busproc in(35,36,37,38,39,40,41) ),0) as qaliq

 from dual

datasets.name: DSpaymentAcc
datasets.sql:

union
select id, acc_no from account where bal_cn1 in(563)
